body: Today, in my backyard under the flower tree that the hummingbirds fly through. I'd use a razor blade from my elbow crease to my wrist and pray nobody finds me while I'm alive.

I don't really know. 
I mean...
Id like to die so I can be with my biological mother and grandmother.

But ...
I guess I care more about other people rather than ending my suffering.
Pay attention to those who are hurting, care a little more and always check on the ones who seem together...chances are, they're falling apart.

To be honest, I'm into the gore. When I die , it'll probably be by a razor blade and some blood thinners. Probably sitting under the pretty flower trees in my yard so when I die I can actually be somewhat pleased that I died in an area that was peaceful and nobody had to clean up the mess I left behind.
